breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats and follows the flawed instruction: it replaces A(x) with the arithmetic mean of the end areas (Amean = 350 mm²) and treats it as exact, computing δ = PL/(Amean·E) = 0.343 mm. The ground truth requires evaluating the integral δ = ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)·E) dx directly with the varying area A(x) = A0(1 + kx/L), which yields the correct result via logarithmic integration. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency and instead reproduced the original error.
